context_requirements: Expression of the targeted growth factor receptor (e.g., NTRK1) or a dependent autocrine/paracrine growth factor loop
Intact downstream signaling through MAPK and/or PI3K-AKT
Lack of strong bypass resistance mechanisms (e.g., PIK3CA mutation, PTEN loss, Axl activation)
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, E2F2) at 24 h in any cell line
No induction of immediate-early genes (e.g., EGR1, FOS, DUSP6) at 6 h in any cell line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine cell lines, including lines lacking the targeted receptor
Predominant induction of apoptosis or DNA damage response rather than G1 arrest

evidence.supports: EGFR inhibitor ZD1839 suppresses EGFR phosphorylation and MAPK activation in patient skin
Cetuximab induces G0-G1 arrest in sensitive colon cancer cells; PIK3CA mutation/PTEN loss confers resistance
FGFR inhibitor PD173074 blocks SCLC proliferation and FGFR transphosphorylation
Axl activation mediates acquired resistance to erlotinib in head and neck cancer cells
EGFR inhibitor OSI-774 affects downstream EGFR signaling and apoptosis in pancreatic cancer xenografts

changes: Moved DUSP6, DUSP4, SPRED2, SOCS2, IER3, ZFP36, CXCL2, CCL2, MMP1, TIMP2 from proximal_up to proximal_down because growth factor receptor inhibition suppresses MAPK/ERK-dependent immediate-early and inflammatory gene transcription.

Moved EGR1, FOS, FOSL1, JUN from proximal_up to proximal_down because these immediate-early genes are induced by growth factor receptor signaling and are typically downregulated upon receptor inhibition.

Moved CDKN1A, CDKN1B, GADD45A, GADD45B, SFN, TSC22D3 from late_up to late_down because growth factor receptor inhibitors cause G1 arrest via decreased CDK activity and reduced expression of these genes, not induction.
Removed DUSP6, SPRED2, SOCS2, IER3, ZFP36, CXCL2, CCL2, TIMP2 from late_up to avoid duplication with proximal_down and because their direction contradicts the mechanism.

Removed MYC, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, E2F2, MYBL2, CDC20, UBE2C, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA from proximal_down because these are generic proliferation genes and should not appear in proximal lists.
Removed MYC, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, E2F2, MYBL2, CDC20, UBE2C, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA from late_down because they are generic proliferation genes and should not appear in late lists.
Changed kinetics from slow to fast because immediate-early gene downregulation occurs within 6 h of growth factor receptor inhibition.
Changed magnitude at 6h from weak to moderate because immediate-early gene suppression is a strong, rapid response.
Changed magnitude at 24h from moderate to weak because the transcriptional response to growth factor receptor inhibition is often transient and may be less pronounced at 24 h.
Changed line_response for A375, A549, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP from weak to none because these lines lack NTRK1 expression or dependency, so a NTRK1 inhibitor would not affect them.
Changed line_response for HA1E from none to weak because HA1E is an immortalized normal cell line with intact growth factor signaling and may show a weak response to receptor inhibition.
